name: One Spa at RACV Cape Schanck Resort
address: Trent Jones Dr, Cape Schanck VIC 3939
signature: The Peninsula's best resort-style day spa, proper scale, serious treatment menu, and a cliff-edge location that nobody else on the Peninsula can match.
editorNote:
One Spa at RACV Cape Schanck sits high on the cliffs above Cape Schanck with Southern Ocean views the whole way, a coastal setting that no boutique day spa on the Peninsula can replicate. It is larger and better equipped than most standalone spa rooms, sits inside a resort with an 18-hole golf course and full accommodation, and runs a treatment menu broad enough to anchor a full wellness day without repeating yourself.

The treatment program is well-executed rather than experimental: massage, facials, body treatments, couples packages, and scrubs from major botanical brands. Therapists are consistently strong. The wet areas, steam, sauna, vitality pool, are where the resort scale shows, and they are better than anything at a standalone day spa on the Peninsula.

The pairing that works: a spa morning here, then a walk on the Cape Schanck lighthouse trail or a round on the resort course, then dinner at the resort or at Jackalope fifteen minutes away. Book midweek if you want the full circuit without feeling rushed, weekend appointments fill three to four weeks out in peak season.
whyWeGo: The combination of resort infrastructure, Southern Ocean views, and a treatment menu broad enough to fill a full day makes this the most complete spa proposition on the Peninsula.
ifOnlyOneThing: Book a couples treatment package for a Tuesday or Wednesday morning, walk the Cape Schanck lighthouse trail afterwards, and eat dinner at the resort that evening.
